lgn.text: Stonebrow and Zagorka lead fugitives from the defeated army to settle an abandoned city, which they name Sanctum.
Stonebrow tries to kill Akroma but is brainwashed to worship Ixidor, and then he leads Topos in war on Sanctum when Akroma vanishes after the deathwurm.
Akroma and Phage battle until Stonebrow injures them both, and Phage flees to give birth.

scg.text: Stonebrow and Zagorka rediscover the city after the Nightmare War, and Zagorka names it Sanctum and welcomes settlers.

The Krosans, led by Stonebrow and Kamahl, smash their way into Sanctum against the Glyphs when Phage's reanimated Cabal army is admitted, and Kamahl charges in on Stonebrow and hurls Soul Reaper to slay both, but Zagorka leaps from a tower to stop it.
